calculation.description: When cross-asset three-day return dispersion is above its trailing 60-day median, buy the volatility-scaled three-day residual losers and sell residual winners in the research signal. Signal is cross-sectionally median demeaned and inactive otherwise.

validation.regime_notes: Daily gate passes across 2,199 active IC observations. Regime IC: 2020-22 +0.05741, 2023-24 +0.04839, 2025-26 +0.05024, 2026-07 through 2027-02-25 +0.03410. Small 15-asset universe; uncertainty interpreted conservatively. Signal is highly correlated with the existing unconditional residual reversal artifact when active and requires deterministic overlap audit.
